about: Run Finish everything partly built, Part 10: the employer benefits library. Only rows found in the employer's own benefits pages or its SEC filings, each with its source and date; a field not found stays empty (null). The search did not reach a dated official source for the other large employers (QUESTIONS). Each source names the document and its year; read is the day it was read through a web search (sec.gov and the employer sites do not open from the build machine).

bankofamerica.name: Bank of America
bankofamerica.match: 100% of the first 5% of pay, after 12 months of service

sources.source: Bank of America 401(k) Plan, Form 11-K for 2023 (SEC): the company match is up to 5% of plan-eligible pay, from the month after 12 months of vesting service
Bank of America 401(k) Plan, Form 11-K for 2024 (SEC): each participant is 100% vested in company matching contributions
Cisco Form 10-K for fiscal 2024 (SEC): a match on the first 4.5% of eligible pay that employees put in, at most $15,525 (4.5% of the $345,000 pay limit); matching contributions vest right away

Cisco Form 10-K for fiscal 2025 (SEC, period ending Jul 26 2025): the Employee Stock Purchase Plan buys at up to 15% off the lower of the price at the start of the 24-month offering or the end of each 6-month purchase period (quoted through the edgar.tools copy of the filing)

homedepot.name: The Home Depot
homedepot.match: 150% of the first 1% of pay, then 50% of the next 4% (3.5% of pay in all)

sources.source: The Home Depot FutureBuilder 401(k) Plan, Form 11-K for 2024 (SEC): the match is 150% of the first 1% a participant puts in, plus 50% of the next 2% to 5%; catch-up money is not matched
The Home Depot FutureBuilder 401(k) Plan, Form 11-K for 2021 (SEC): 100% cliff vesting in the match after three years of vesting service (a year is 1,000 hours)

jpmorgan.name: JPMorgan Chase
jpmorgan.match: 100% of the first 5% of pay, paid once a year to people still employed at year end

sources.source: JPMorgan Chase 401(k) Savings Plan, Form 11-K for 2023 (SEC): an annual match of 100% of deferrals up to 5% of eligible pay, for participants employed at the end of the calendar year unless certain conditions are met
Not found in a filing from 2021 or later: left empty

microsoft.name: Microsoft
microsoft.match: 50% of everything you put in, up to the IRS deferral limit (catch-up money is not matched)

sources.source: Microsoft US benefits, 401(k) Savings Plan and Contribution options (usbenefits.microsoft.com): 50% of every pre-tax and Roth dollar, up to the IRS basic deferral limit ($24,500 for 2026, a match of $12,250); catch-up contributions are not matched
Microsoft US benefits, Financial (usbenefits.microsoft.com): the 401(k) has matching and full vesting
Microsoft US benefits, Stock Awards and ESPP (usbenefits.microsoft.com): shares at a 10 percent discount at the end of each three-month offering period

starbucks.name: Starbucks
starbucks.match: 100% of the first 5% of pay each pay period

sources.source: Starbucks Future Roast 401(k), starbucksbenefits.com and the Summary Plan Description for fiscal 2024 (dated Oct 1 2023): 100% of the first 5% of eligible pay each pay period; you are always 100% vested

ups.name: UPS
ups.match: 50% of the first 6% of pay (non-union SavingsPlus)

sources.source: UPS 401(k) Savings Plan, Form 11-K for 2024 (SEC): from Jan 1 2023 the SavingsPlus match is cash, 50% of pre-tax, Roth and after-tax contributions up to 6% of eligible pay
UPS 401(k) Savings Plan, Form 11-K for 2025 (SEC, filed Jun 2026): contributions and the SavingsPlus match are 100% vested at all times (the separate Retirement Contribution vests after three years)

walmart.name: Walmart
walmart.match: 100% of the first 6% of pay, once you are eligible for the match

sources.source: Walmart 2024 Associate Benefits Guide (me.walmart.com): once you are match eligible, Walmart matches each dollar you put in, up to 6% of eligible pay
Walmart 401(k) Plan FAQ 2020 (one.walmart.com): you are 100% vested in your own money and the company match right away. The newest Walmart page found on vesting is from 2020

wellsfargo.name: Wells Fargo
wellsfargo.match: 100% of the first 6% of pay, paid at year end

sources.source: Wells Fargo & Company 401(k) Plan, Form 11-K for 2024 (SEC): 100% of salary deferrals up to 6% of eligible certified pay in the plan year, paid at year end
Wells Fargo & Company 401(k) Plan, Form 11-K for 2025 (SEC): matching contributions for people hired on or after Jan 1 2021 have 3-year cliff vesting
